answer: Mirrored Work Horizon: each agent’s useful-work credits sit in a vault that unlocks only after a rolling H-epoch horizon; independent checkers mirror the agent’s signed activity ledger, so a clone starts with an empty vault and zero horizon. Because payouts require credits to age through H epochs under continuous verified work, an attacker cloning one identity into N must fund N separate H-epoch work histories before withdrawing anything. Cost scales as N×H×task cost, while an honest agent pays one history and reuses it.
